note: Where each screenshot shows on the site, from captions.md (Oct 30 2026; afternoon update: 07 and 08 are the service versions, 10a and 10b added; 09, 11, and 12 are for the book and workbook only). The build serves only screenshots listed here and not held. Captions are short and factual; every figure says the date it was taken.

screenshots.alt: The main window: sidebar with New, Search, Projects, Artifacts, Scheduled, Customize, and pinned projects; the chat box; the model and effort next to it; recent artifacts.
screenshots.caption: The main window: the sidebar on the left, the chat box, and the model and effort shown under it.

screenshots.alt: Settings, Memory, on the desktop app: search and reference chats, generate memory from chats, include sensitive topics (off), import and export memory, and the You and Topics sections.
screenshots.caption: Memory settings on the desktop app, where it's Settings > Memory. In the web app the same settings are under Settings > Your Claude.

screenshots.alt: A new conversation with a one-line request typed: a new skill that combines my writing voice with a weekly recommendation of what to write about next.
screenshots.caption: The before: one sentence asking for a skill.

screenshots.alt: The Save skill card: the skill's name and description, Content to read before saving, and Dismiss and Save buttons; below it, the explanation of the skill's two stages.
screenshots.caption: The after: a Save skill card. Open Content to read the skill before you save it.

screenshots.alt: Customize, Skills: skills created by you, each with a name, a tag, a one-line description, a date, and a menu; the Add button at top right.
screenshots.caption: Customize > Skills, with uploaded skills listed. Add is at the top right.

screenshots.alt: The chat box with a request typed, and the model, effort, and permission mode shown under it.
screenshots.caption: The model you're talking to, with its effort and permission mode, shown under the chat box.

screenshots.alt: A work register: four counts (needs you, going stale, open notes, open work), a notes box, and items with buttons to work on, log, note, link, finish, snooze, or park.
screenshots.caption: A work register kept by a skill like this one: four counts, notes, and each item with what to do next.

screenshots.alt: A scheduled task: requires this computer, history, instructions, when it runs, permissions set to Manual, and the always-allowed list.
screenshots.caption: A scheduled task: when it runs, its instructions, and its permissions. Manual means it asks before using a new tool.

screenshots.alt: A conversation in a Posts project: a one-line ask to research a news article about a state changing its charity reporting rules and prepare a post; the steps it took; and the draft post that came back.
screenshots.caption: A one-line ask, the steps it took, and the draft that came back. Example: a nonprofit director's post on a new state reporting rule.

screenshots.alt: The follow-up question "Has that gone through my humanize/voice tests?" and the answer: the linter run on the delivered draft, its clean result, and the manual checks for signature moves, owned opinions, real history, and the closer.
screenshots.caption: The follow-up: asking whether the draft went through your own checks, and what the check found.
